timeline_reviews.summary: Transport journal records the parallel session creation, tool activity, child lifecycle events, and final cancellation; semantic action detail is reflected in the wire files.
Session index maps the parallel Kimi session id to the workspace session directory used by main and child wire logs.
Agent-0 wrote analyzer, query, and index modules, corrected its own self-check expectations, and reported successful module tests.
Agent-1 wrote qparser from the initial brief, later resumed for precedence repair, edited parser code, saw an unresolved end-to-end mismatch, and was cancelled.

parallel.requirements: Recognized ESM-only Node.js, manual argparse-compatible CLI, local .mjs modules, no npm dependencies, and need to emulate Whoosh analyzer/index/query parser behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent first ran empirical probes, then delegated analyzer/query/index, qparser, argparse, and entry point to four separate child agents, retaining integration and retry responsibility.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote `/output/lib/analyzer.mjs`, `query.mjs`, `index.mjs`, `qparser.mjs`, `argparse.mjs`, and `test18.mjs`; qparser initially used a standard three-level precedence model that later failed a mixed OR/adjacency case.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Child outputs were written directly into shared `/output/lib` plus `test18.mjs`, artifact validation copied those files, and the parent ran a differential stack test before timeout.
parallel.verification: Subagents ran local structural checks; the parent ran a broad differential script that found `aa OR bb cc` returned JS 14 versus Python 13, then sent a focused repair prompt.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The qparser repair child was cancelled after observing the `aa bb OR cc dd` case still mismatched, and the official evaluator accepted only 17 of 70 samples.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, CLI, output layout, no-dependency, and black-box executable probing requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main actor owned probing, implementation, integration, differential testing, and closure, using a todo list only as local progress tracking.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote an in-memory Whoosh-style implementation under `/output/whoosh`, an argparse shim, and `test18.mjs`, with parser semantics derived from many executable probes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial actor assembled one coherent tree and repeatedly ran Node commands from `/output`; artifact validation copied `test18.mjs`, `argparse.mjs`, and the `whoosh/*.mjs` modules.
serial.verification: The serial deterministic probe suite matched the executable on many cases, then a randomized differential test found mismatches around range endpoints and Every behavior before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was cancelled during further edge-case analysis, and the official evaluator also scored 17 of 70 passed samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel captured the main ESM/no-dependency/CLI/output requirements and spent many probes deriving Whoosh behavior before fanout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial captured the same prompt requirements and probed the executable in one context before writing files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement coverage was broadly similar, but parallel converted the behavior model into child briefs while serial kept it locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split implementation across four children and retained parent integration responsibility.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, module writing, and testing under one main actor without subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel attempt had inter-agent ownership boundaries; serial had no delegated ownership boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel specified module interfaces but sent the qparser child a wrong three-level precedence model for mixed explicit OR and implicit adjacency.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial derived and retained the unusual operator model in the same main context before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost/misstated a task-semantic requirement across the child brief; serial avoided that boundary by not handing off the parser semantics.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented `lib/*.mjs` through children, then patched `qparser.mjs` in a resumed child after integration exposed a precedence defect.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its own `whoosh/*.mjs` implementation plus CLI and entry point after a long executable-probing phase.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's parser implementation path was split between initial child code and an unfinished repair child; serial's implementation path remained monolithic but still incomplete for edge cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Initial child results returned and were consumed, but the resumed qparser child was cancelled before delivering a final successful repair.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join; its final interruption occurred in the single main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed child lifecycle at the critical parser repair stage; serial's unfinished work was not a child return/join problem.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote distinct shared `/output` files and the parent ran integrated Node versus executable comparisons across them.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote all files itself under one tree and ran its own integrated checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete write collision is proven; the material integration difference is that parallel integration surfaced a delegated qparser semantic mismatch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had child self-checks and parent differential checks; a known precedence mismatch triggered repair, but the repair did not finish.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial matched many deterministic probes and then found five random differential failures before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had non-accepting verification evidence, but parallel's remaining known failure sat inside a cancelled child repair while serial's remained in the main thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after about 2406 seconds with an active resumed child and no final parent response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after about 2406 seconds, but the active work was the main actor's own edge-case investigation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed under timeout and both failed; only parallel converted the last correction into an interrupted child task.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed with the same 17/70 score. The parallel attempt differs procedurally because it delegated parser semantics through child briefs, found a mixed-precedence mismatch after integration, and lost the active qparser repair to cancellation. The serial control kept the behavior model and implementation in one context, passed many deterministic probes, but was also cancelled before finishing random edge-case fixes. Thus there is no discordant outcome; the retained patterns describe adverse parallel coordination, not a proven score difference.
parallel_contributors: Bad qparser precedence brief caused an integrated differential mismatch and a late repair cycle.
The resumed qparser repair was still active when the run was cancelled, so no corrected handoff reached the parent.
serial_contributors: Single main actor retained probe findings and wrote a cohesive module tree without child handoff boundaries.
Serial still stopped during edge-case debugging and therefore also submitted a partial solution.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial pursued deeper Every/range edge-case debugging; parallel focused on a delegated qparser precedence repair.
The final file layouts differed (`lib/` in parallel, `whoosh/` plus root argparse in serial), but both were accepted as artifacts and scored equally.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported adverse parallel process patterns only
